gui.enchantmod.research.title: Research
rune.enchantmod.uruz.desc: Strength. Boost rune: +1 level for each one connected.
rune.enchantmod.thurisaz.desc: Thorn, force. Part of Bane of Arthropods, Thorns and Punch.
rune.enchantmod.ansuz.desc: Breath, speech. Part of Feather Falling.
rune.enchantmod.raidho.desc: Journey. Not used by any core yet.
rune.enchantmod.kenaz.desc: Torch, fire. Part of Fire Protection and Flame.
rune.enchantmod.gebo.desc: Gift. Part of Silk Touch, with Isa.
rune.enchantmod.wunjo.desc: Joy. Not used by any core yet.
rune.enchantmod.nauthiz.desc: Need. Not used by any core yet.
rune.enchantmod.isa.desc: Ice, stillness. Core of Unbreaking. Part of Silk Touch and Frost Walker.
rune.enchantmod.jera.desc: Year, renewal. Core of Mending. Part of Infinity.
rune.enchantmod.eihwaz.desc: Yew, the bow. Core of Power. Part of Flame, Punch and Infinity.
rune.enchantmod.perthro.desc: Hidden lot. Not used by any core yet.
rune.enchantmod.algiz.desc: Protection. Core of Protection. Part of the other protections.
rune.enchantmod.tiwaz.desc: Victory. Core of Sharpness. Part of Smite, Looting and others.
rune.enchantmod.ehwaz.desc: Horse, movement. Part of Sweeping Edge.
rune.enchantmod.mannaz.desc: Humanity. Stabilizer rune: needed from level 5.
rune.enchantmod.laguz.desc: Water. Part of Respiration and Frost Walker.
rune.enchantmod.ingwaz.desc: Seed. Not used by any core yet.
rune.enchantmod.dagaz.desc: Dawn. Stabilizer rune: needed from level 10.
rune.enchantmod.othala.desc: Heritage. Not used by any core yet.
gui.enchantmod.research.hint: Join the runes with a line. Add Uruz for more levels.
research.enchantmod.efficiency: Speeds up digging with a tool. Berkana is growth, so the work grows faster.
research.enchantmod.unbreaking: Makes an item wear out more slowly. Isa is stillness: it holds its shape.
research.enchantmod.fortune: Mined blocks drop more. Fehu is wealth.
research.enchantmod.mending: Mends the item with the experience you collect. Jera is renewal over time.
research.enchantmod.silk_touch: Mines blocks whole instead of breaking them. Gebo is a gift, Isa keeps it unchanged.
research.enchantmod.sharpness: A weapon deals more damage. Tiwaz is victory, the spear god.
research.enchantmod.smite: Extra damage to the undead. Victory (Tiwaz) with the sun (Sowilo).
research.enchantmod.bane_of_arthropods: Extra damage to spiders and insects. Victory (Tiwaz) with the thorn (Thurisaz).
research.enchantmod.knockback: Hits push targets away. Thurisaz is thorn and force.
research.enchantmod.fire_aspect: Sets targets on fire. Kenaz is the torch.
research.enchantmod.looting: Slain mobs drop more. Victory (Tiwaz) with wealth (Fehu).
research.enchantmod.sweeping_edge: A sword sweeps wider. Victory (Tiwaz) with the horse (Ehwaz), movement.
research.enchantmod.protection: Armour takes less damage. Algiz is protection.
research.enchantmod.fire_protection: Less fire damage. A ward (Algiz) against the torch (Kenaz).
research.enchantmod.blast_protection: Less explosion damage. A ward (Algiz) against hail (Hagalaz).
research.enchantmod.feather_falling: Softer falls. A ward (Algiz) with breath (Ansuz).
research.enchantmod.respiration: Breathe longer underwater. A ward (Algiz) with water (Laguz).
research.enchantmod.thorns: Attackers take damage. A ward (Algiz) with the thorn (Thurisaz).
research.enchantmod.depth_strider: Move faster in water. Water (Laguz) with movement (Ehwaz).
research.enchantmod.frost_walker: Freezes water under your feet. Water (Laguz) with stillness (Isa).
research.enchantmod.soul_speed: Move faster on soul sand. Movement (Ehwaz) and need (Nauthiz).
research.enchantmod.swift_sneak: Sneak faster. Movement (Ehwaz) and the hidden lot (Perthro).
research.enchantmod.power: A bow deals more damage. Eihwaz is the yew, the bow.
research.enchantmod.flame: Arrows set targets on fire. The bow (Eihwaz) and the torch (Kenaz).
research.enchantmod.punch: Arrows knock targets back. The bow (Eihwaz) and force (Thurisaz).
research.enchantmod.infinity: Shooting costs no arrows. The bow (Eihwaz) and renewal (Jera).
